<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="ranged-hm-zemouregal-vorkath" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Ranged HM Zemouregal &amp; Vorkath</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/FysXlFOwOW.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This rotation is consistent for farming and yields multiple GM timers per hour, without flight skips</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ranged </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179716885265252382.png?v=1" alt="dracolichcoif" title="dracolichcoif" kind="icon" /><nowiki> flight skips are very inconsistent and risky</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Expect times from 1:43 to 1:53 when done correctly</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ For safer but slower farming, you can swap in </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1" alt="hellhoundpouch" title="hellhoundpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417822188437569.png?v=1" alt="scriptureofamascut" title="scriptureofamascut" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Downgrades will require some improv on P4 Zemouregal</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=4f7f5e4b-d10d-4a6b-9d08-d18e844b4bbf <nowiki>Ranged</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F4f7f5e4b-d10d-4a6b-9d08-d18e844b4bbf.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Slayer task priority: blue dragon &gt; dragon cluster &gt; undead</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1" alt="undeadslayer" title="undeadslayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1" alt="undeadslayerperk" title="undeadslayerperk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> used</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Camp </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1" alt="salveamulet" title="salveamulet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697042755584.png?v=1" alt="jasdragonbanearrow" title="jasdragonbanearrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on Vorkath and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/745279787471470713.png?v=1" alt="eof" title="eof" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1" alt="fularrow" title="fularrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on Zemouregal</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Switch to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1" alt="deathsporearrows" title="deathsporearrows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as directed</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/933079947419983912.png?v=1" alt="powderofprotection" title="powderofprotection" kind="icon" /><nowiki> optional for sustain</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ T100 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1" alt="bolg" title="bolg" kind="icon" /><nowiki> using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266418218264694954.png?v=1" alt="shardofgenesisessence" title="shardofgenesisessence" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The following are </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> needed: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1" alt="ecb" title="ecb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088589627505.png?v=1" alt="eq4" title="eq4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1" alt="genocidal" title="genocidal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1" alt="wenarrows" title="wenarrows" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Camp </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809111178813471.png?v=1" alt="deflectnecromancy" title="deflectnecromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and switch to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> during first </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /></p>

</nowiki>

</nowiki>
